scripts.seed: docker compose exec backend bundle exec rails runner db/seeds_only_rovers.rb
scripts.scrape:perseverance: docker compose exec backend bundle exec rake scrape_perseverance
scripts.scrape:curiosity: docker compose exec backend bundle exec rake scrape_curiosity
scripts.db:migrate: docker compose exec backend bundle exec rake db:migrate
scripts.rails:console: docker compose exec backend bundle exec rails console
scripts.db:dump: docker compose exec db pg_dump -U ${DB_USERNAME:-mars} -d ${DB_NAME:-mars_curiosity_production} --format=custom -f /tmp/mars_dump.backup && docker compose cp db:/tmp/mars_dump.backup ./mars_dump.backup
scripts.db:restore: docker compose cp ./mars_dump.backup db:/tmp/mars_dump.backup && docker compose exec db pg_restore -U ${DB_USERNAME:-mars} -d ${DB_NAME:-mars_curiosity_production} --clean --if-exists /tmp/mars_dump.backup
